name: @steuererklaerung/charts
author: Pascal Garber
description: Framework-agnostic chart + data-viz geometry (bars, line/area, sparkline, category shares, axis ticks). Pure TypeScript — NO DOM, NO GTK, NO node built-ins — so the same math feeds the web SVG component, the native GTK snapshot widget, and unit tests. Designed to be liftable into gjsify as a reusable @gjsify/charts package.
